deliveryOrder: Verify new normal named SDK stage hashes/Native metadata and preserve all dependency-owned SDK/package metadata.
Retire only the enumerated Git-matching old files, preserving standalone notices and sibling source attribution. Never recursively delete examples roots that contain user IDE state.
Install complete xge/xui/_xge_native ABI2 packages from each platform final normal stage, without mixing v2 source files or flattening paths.
Replace the enumerated 76 old XL and two old runners with the maintained example sets/README under runtime/examples/xge and xui; retain byte-exact archive/index in dev/release-materials/sources.
Retain existing nine exact notices; add frozen production dependency notice/provenance files, keep optional 3D/test assets separate, and refresh only mutable material/current-delivery indexes.
Keep fonts, resources, user settings/projects/updater data and GUI engine xge.dll; do not touch independent runtime/compiler/LSP binaries in this package-swap operation.

notes: Two old generated resource .inc files are implementation copies, not disposable resources: the matched engine parent object dependency files prove the frozen replacements were compiled. Keep underlying res assets/notices in the frozen sibling material bundle and preserve runtime data/fonts.

Existing material-index whole-file hashes for sokol_app.h and xrt.h differ from the latest frozen headers; this reports code/header differences, not a conclusion that license text changed. Refresh the mutable index using new frozen source paths/hashes without rewriting old snapshots.

Both platform sets contain 60 normal-stage package files plus 13 maintained example/README destinations each. The 13 source-package example copies are dependency-owned package contents; standalone runtime/examples delivery is an additional explicit product layout.
No actual hidden .xlang-ide path, filename, count or hash is included. Only the generic exclusion policy is recorded.
